My wife has a history of high blood pressure and is on medication, yet her condition has been repeatedly ignored by the practice.

Over the past four months, she has provided her blood pressure readings four times, with readings as high as 145-150, but there has been no feedback, follow-up, or guidance from the practice. Given that hypertension is a serious condition requiring monitoring and timely intervention, this level of neglect is completely unacceptable.

Coming from a developing country, I expected the UK’s healthcare system to be more efficient and patient-focused. However, the lack of care and communication at this practice is shocking. In any other healthcare system, such negligence in managing a critical condition would be unimaginable even not in 3rd world 😐

Patients should not have to chase their GP for medical attention, especially for conditions that require ongoing monitoring. I strongly urge Shimmin & Partners to improve its responsiveness, duty of care, and communication with patients. If this level of service continues, it could have serious consequences for people’s health.
